findings.title: Do not use Java MessageFormat syntax in the account UI bundle
findings.body: This is a JavaScript account UI translation bundle, whose interpolation syntax is `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, etc. (as used by the previous value and other entries in this file). Replacing it with Java `MessageFormat` syntax and a `choice` expression means the client translation layer will not interpolate the attribute or bounds and will render `{0}`, `{1}`, and `{2,choice,...}` literally in validation errors. Keep the client-side placeholder syntax and implement pluralization using the UI i18n mechanism if needed.

findings.title: Do not use Java MessageFormat syntax in the admin UI bundle
findings.body: The admin console message resources use the JavaScript i18n interpolation form `{{0}}`, as the removed value did. The new `{0}`/`{1}` placeholders and Java `choice` grammar are not interpreted by that client-side formatter, so multivalued-attribute validation errors will expose the raw formatting expression instead of the attribute name and limits. Restore the client bundle's interpolation format and use its pluralization support rather than Java MessageFormat syntax.

findings.title: Lithuanian account message was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `messages_lt.properties` is the Lithuanian bundle, but the new `totpStep1` value is Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare"). Lithuanian account users will see an unrelated language when configuring TOTP; replace it with the intended Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The `loginTotpStep1` entry in the Lithuanian login bundle now contains the same Italian sentence ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare"). This is user-visible during login-time TOTP setup and should be translated into Lithuanian rather than copied from another locale.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now contains Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `messages_zh_CN.properties` is the Simplified Chinese locale, but the replacement `totpStep1` uses Traditional Chinese characters and vocabulary such as "手機" and "應用程式", unlike the surrounding Simplified Chinese strings. Use a Simplified Chinese translation for this `zh_CN` resource; Traditional Chinese belongs in the `zh_TW` bundle.
